reviews.review: If you play strategy games long enough, you will find out that they removed the features that made modern strategy games. The game is about numbers. No defense, no armor, no cover no cover, just HP, damage and heals. Start of the game, first 3 random event instantly removes a squad from your roster permanently. 16 enemy squads rushing your max 5 squad is almost impossible to win and it takes all the fun out. Grinding and more grinding. I hit you and you hit me. Text events repeat on the same journey. Poor group formation and half the squad queuing up to fight. It really sucks when we have to keep pausing the game and manual click click click when the AI is really dumb. The negative reviews weren't kidding. I tried to make a group of 5 fighting healers and really made all the way to the end but the game is so unfun I literally fall asleep. The impression the dev gives me is that they do not really know what a roguelike game is, it is a game that requires skill in a hard set up, not grinding and cockblocking. This game is definitely a no go. No chance for dev. Dev needs to play more roguelike.
